titan_a_fortification.label: Fortification
titan_a_fortification.description: Titan-A Fortify: Fortifies your ships and 2-13 alliance ships (+25% additive Critical Hit Damage). Checking this marks you Fortified for combat research that requires Fortify.
provenance_notes: Static +25% additive critical hit damage (`crit_damage_flat: 0.25`) comes from Titan-A Fortify and was live-verified 2026-11-28 across 297 outbound crits in U.S.S. Dauntless vs L65 Planet Harvester logs (R3+ midpoint 10.71x = 9.46x baseline + 1.00 Titan's Spear + 0.25 Fortify).

Fortified-gated combat research is curated separately in src/data/profile/mod.rs, data/research_canonical.json, and src/data/native_consumable_buffs.rs and applied only when this support buff resolves.

titan_a_max_fortification.label: Max fortification
titan_a_max_fortification.description: Titan-A Fortify (max): all Fortified effects +250% additive base weapon damage. Checking this marks you Max Fortified for combat research that requires Fortify or Max Fortification.
provenance_notes: Max Fortification keeps the +25% additive critical hit damage (`crit_damage_flat: 0.25`) and adds +250% additive base weapon damage (`weapon_damage_additive_pool: 2.5`) into the shared base weapon-damage pool (live-verified 2026-11-28 not multiplicative 3.5x).

Max-only Fortified combat research is curated separately in src/data/profile/mod.rs, data/research_canonical.json, and src/data/native_consumable_buffs.rs and applied only when this support buff resolves.
